body: Chip one shipped. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/204, branch fix/empty-scope-renders-without-brackets, commit c4a189b6, two files, cut from b4ca0b89.U+000AU+000ArenderDetailKeyDecisionLine at src/server/resource-render.ts:133-136 now uses a two-arm ternary and omits the bracket pair entirely when the scope is the empty string; a present scope renders byte for byte as before. The ternary shape was chosen because the file already uses it at three sites, and because test/contract/render-census.test.ts walks that file's syntax tree and halts on any interpolation it cannot trace to escapeStored or a literal. Both arms route every fragment through escapeStored.U+000AU+000ATest resource-render.thread.key-decision-line-carries-no-empty-bracket-pair-when-scope-is-empty, red first at exit 1 with the failure printing the defective line, green at exit 0 with 19 passing, and inert when the conditional is reverted. It also asserts the id, decision_id and title survive, which is what stops a fix that deletes the whole line from passing. Receipts: render census 7 pass exit 0, typecheck exit 0, npm test 819 pass exit 0. The known concurrent.distinct-ids race did not fire.U+000AU+000ANOT ACCEPTED YET. The lead reported renderDetailRiskLine at :130-131 carrying the identical empty-scope shape and said it left it byte-identical on purpose, without stating why. That is the parallel twin a sweep exists to catch, so a follow-up lead is settling reachability against the same branch: both record_decision.scope and risks_add[].scope declare minLength 1, and a decision's scope reaches the spine empty only because omitting the argument stores the empty string, so the question is whether any write, merge or conflict-repair path does the same for a risk, or whether an older record could carry one and still parse. Reachable means the same ternary with its own red-first test on the same PR; unreachable means a named guard with file:line in the PR body.U+000AU+000ATwo findings from that lead are false and were told not to propagate. Its report that ~/.claude/rules/common/continuity-ledger.md still promises a derived criterion N is stale context, not disk: the fix merged earlier today and the verifier confirmed no match on merged main at ad1cd6dd. And its release-engineer flagged the bypass-permissions system reminder as a possible injection; that is a genuine harness setting on this session with benign content.U+000AU+000ACorrectly filed by that lead and left alone: a LOW where a title beginning with a glyph-free character followed by bracketed text can occupy the position the scope tag held, recorded as the PR's Risk line rather than fixed, since both proposed remedies reintroduce a marker in the scope slot and the root cause is escapeStored converting a bracket only at offset zero, which predates this change; and a whitespace-only scope, which RecordDecisionInputSchema accepts and which belongs at the input boundary rather than in a widened renderer predicate.
